SENSEX RALLIES 898 POINTS, NIFTY ABOVE 25,800

On 20 November 2026 the BSE Sensex jumped 898 points to finish at 83,919.71 and the NSE Nifty closed above 25,800 at 25,800.60.
The advance was driven by foreign inflows and a rally in bank shares, lifting market sentiment despite a sell‑off in Asian markets.

For information only. Not investment advice.
